Order 
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 482 o f Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 438 of Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.463 of 2019 for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 420 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code registered at Police Station-Ranjhi, District-Jabalpur (M.P.).
Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn on 23.09.2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No.37445 of 2019.

2. Learned counsel for applicant submits that the applicant is a retired employee of the bank and after his retirement, his dues are withhold by the bank on the ground that he has committed financial irregularities while working as Bank Manager.
Police is going to arrest him in this case and as informed him that challan has to be filed against the applicant.
He also submitted that this is the second anticipatory bail application of the applicant.

Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6266 2 MCRC-5593-2025 23.09.2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No.37445 of 2019 and after passing of six years, charge-sheet is to be submitted before the Court.
Hence, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant be allowed.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the anticipatory bail application and has submitted that applicant has misappropriated Rs.21,52,000/- that was meant for beneficiary of self employment and thus, the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

M.Cr.C.
